meta.summary: Hides app pop-ups and download promos; Show/Dim/Blur or Hide for tiles, videos, avatars, Spotlight captions and buttons
meta.notes:
## 2026-11-13 additions (LIVE, headless Chrome via puppeteer, logged out)
Pages: `/` (iPhone UA 390x844 and macOS Safari UA 1280x800), `/@mrbeast` (both), `/spotlight` (redirects to `/@<user>/spotlight/<id>`, iPhone). Counts are `querySelectorAll` totals (visible):
- `[data-testid="subscribersCountText"]` 1 (1) profile mobile+desktop.
- `[role="tab"]:has([data-testid="related-section-heading-wrapper"])` 1 (1); tabs are All, Stories, Spotlight, Related.
- `li:has(> a[data-testid="navItem-PLUS"])` 1 (visible only on desktop; 0 visible at 390px); `[data-testid="ConsumerNav_DownloadButton"]` 1, same.
- `nav:has(> [data-testid="home-advertisers-link"])` 1 (1) on mobile home (Advertisers, Creators, Developers links).
- `[data-testid="profilePicture"]` 7 (4 visible: header avatar and search-result bubbles).
- `[data-testid="content-tile"] img, ... video` 18 (9 visible: 15 images and 3 videos); Spotlight `[data-testid="spotlight-player"] video` 1. Blur is applied to the wrapper of a video (`div:has(> video)`, `div[role="region"]`), not to the `<video>` itself: Chromium composites a video on its own layer and ignores a filter set on it (checked with a screenshot).
- `spotlight-metadata` 2 and `spotlight-sound` 1; `spotlight-engagement-rail` 2 (active and next slide), all visible.
## New options
- **Choices:** Thumbnails and videos (Show/Dim/Blur), Profile pictures (Show/Blur/Hide), Spotlight caption and Spotlight buttons (Show/Dim/Hide). Dim is `opacity: 0.35`, Blur is `filter: blur(8px..14px)`.
- **Toggles:** Snapchat+ promo (annoyance, on), business links, follower count, Related tab (content, off).
- The desktop Download button joined **Hide Open Snapchat bars**.
## Original check (LIVE, iPhone UA, 2026-11-08)
Home, profile, `/discover`, `/topic`, Spotlight. No cookie banner, sign-in wall or timed pop-up in 30 s. `mobile-cta-bottom-sheet` on home is an empty aria-hidden placeholder, so no rule targets it. Comment button is the third button of the rail (position based). Class-substring anchors (`downloadButton`, `mobileSlides`, `__count`, `CountCard_card`, `EndOfFeedPrompt_inlineContainer`, `Footer_entertainmentBar`) use the CSS-module name before the hash and may be renamed by a rebuild. Desktop home (macOS UA, 2026-11-10): `home-desktop-slides` and `home-parents` match.
## Not verified
- Logged-in app, Stories player pages, `/@snapchat` ("content not found").
- Tapping a blurred or dimmed tile still opens it; CSS cannot un-blur on tap.
- Fixtures are distilled and hand-extended: profile.html gained the desktop nav, avatar, followers line, Related tab and tile image; spotlight.html the sound line; home.html the business links.
